matrix.goal: Read the docs or inspect examples
required: Git if you clone the repository
Node.js 18 or newer with npm, or Rust 1.85 or newer with Cargo

matrix.goal: Create and build a native game
required: One package manager: pnpm, npm, or Yarn
Native linker/backend dependencies for the host
wasm-opt is optional for size optimization
The Perry target setup for the selected platform
Android SDK/NDK for the selected target

entries.title: BornEngine CLI
entries.notes: The npm launcher needs Node.js 18 or newer and downloads a checksum-verified native program on first use. Downloads exist for Linux x86-64, Windows x86-64, and macOS (Intel and Apple silicon). To build from source instead, use Rust 1.85 or newer: cargo install --git https://github.com/RuanFernandes/bornengine-cli

entries.title: Rust and Cargo
entries.scope: Native builds and source install of the CLI
entries.notes: The Rust installation guide is also available at https://www.rust-lang.org/tools/install. Native builds compile the engine's Rust library with Cargo. Installing the CLI from source needs Rust 1.85 or newer.

entries.title: Node.js
entries.scope: CLI launcher and project package installation
entries.notes: The CLI's npm launcher needs Node.js 18 or newer. The @bornengine/engine package declares Node.js 22.18 or newer, so use that for game projects.

entries.title: npm
entries.scope: CLI install and project package installation

entries.title: Perry
entries.scope: Native, Apple, Android, and Web targets
entries.notes: bornengine perry install downloads the Perry build attached to a BornEngine GitHub release (the latest by default) for Linux x86-64, Windows x86-64, or macOS. Set BORNENGINE_PERRY to use another binary. bornengine perry path prints plain perry when nothing is installed, so use bornengine doctor to confirm that Perry starts.

entries.title: wasm-pack
entries.notes: Web builds also need the WebAssembly Rust target: rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown.

entries.title: Xcode
entries.notes: Xcode provides the Apple SDKs and simulators required by the selected target. Native macOS builds need at least the Command Line Tools: xcode-select --install.

entries.title: Android Studio
entries.notes: Install the Android SDK and NDK components required by the selected Perry target.

entries.title: Windows C++ Build Tools
entries.notes: Use the Developer Command Prompt when checking cl.exe. Install the Desktop development with C++ workload. Perry also supports a lighter LLVM-based setup described in its installation guide. When lld-link.exe is on PATH, the CLI passes it to Perry and Cargo as the linker.

entries.title: Linux backend packages
entries.install: sudo apt install build-essential pkg-config libx11-dev libxi-dev libasound2-dev
entries.notes: pkg-config with the X11, XI, and ALSA development files is the set that bornengine doctor checks. A C compiler and linker are also required (build-essential on Debian and Ubuntu). On Fedora: sudo dnf install gcc gcc-c++ glibc-devel pkgconf-pkg-config libX11-devel libXi-devel alsa-lib-devel. Other distributions use different package names.
